issues.description: PersonResource constructor is incorrect in the solution: the template (and required layered architecture) injects PersonService via `public PersonResource(PersonService personService)`, but the solution defines `public PersonResource(NoteService noteService)` and assigns `this.personService = null`. This breaks Spring dependency injection and will cause a NullPointerException when any endpoint calls `personService`.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution `PersonResource`, change the constructor to `public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; }` and remove the erroneous NoteService parameter and null assignment.
